electrical.rails: External 3.3V camera module profile VDD-GND 2.7..3.6V, explicit rails; NOT bare-die core/analog voltage qualification. Bare die datasheet separately specifies core1.3V, analog2.5..3.0V, I/O1.7..3.3V.
electrical.drive: NativeNet finite 40-ohm D0..D7/PCLK/HREF/VSYNC branches to own explicit VDD/GND. Unknown rails remain UNKNOWN, never a fabricated off/reset epoch.
electrical.input: Resolved terminal RESET active low, PWDN active high and actual XCLK transitions only. XCLK measured rising-to-rising; one-nanosecond quantization jitter tolerated. Four measured periods without an edge stop production. No fallback20MHz, no surrogate MCU peer, no GPIO input injection.
electrical.power_reset: Generic registered endpoint power_epoch is sole power-cycle authority. RESET low and COM7[7] reset banked volatile registers. Default bank selector0x7f selects bank1; PID0x2641 and MID0x7fa2 are read-only. Settling10ms is named functional-profile driver-compatible delay.
electrical.consumer_boundary: Controller parent consumes only resolved matrix/pad DVP edges. Source capture is resolved sensor-terminal emission evidence, never a CAM RX delivery claim.

sccb.owner: I2cNativeWorker existing controller/electrical binding; actual SDA/SCL reachability, power and stable registered component ID select external dispatch.
sccb.registers: Two 256-byte banks, BANK_SEL0xff, register pointer preserved across STOP or repeated-start, SS_CTRL[5] autoincrement, read-only IDs, COM7 reset, BPADDR/BPDATA indexed storage, read/write retention for component settings. Publicly XX factory-reserved reset reads NACK until a value is written; never silently return fabricated zero.
sccb.qualification_limit: I2C owner reports existing controller transaction timing fast path is NOT physical bit-edge-qualified SCCB. This service supplies complete live callbacks, not an address-only response or a second bus model. Physical SCCB edge qualification remains an explicit owner dependency.

source_scene.scene_dimensions: COM7 resolution selects UXGA1600x1200, SVGA800x600 or CIF400x296.
source_scene.crop: Output dimensions4*(ZMOW|ZMHHwidthbits),4*(ZMOH|ZMHHheightbit), bounded1600x1200. Input window4*(HSIZE/VHYX/TEST),4*(VSIZE/VHYX). Coordinates use XOFFL/YOFFL and VHYX high bits. Mirror/flip output coordinate first, then offset+floor(output_coordinate*window_size/output_size). Window must lie inside scene.
source_scene.color-bars: floor(8*x/scene_width): white,yellow,cyan,green,magenta,red,blue,black; channel values0 or255. COM7[1] overrides testimage with these declared bars, not an optical silicon calibration claim.
source_scene.rgb565: R5/G6/B5, high byte first unless IMAGE_MODE[0] swaps byte pair.
source_scene.yuv422: Y=16+floor((66R+129G+25B+128)/256); U=128+floor((-38R-74G+112B+128)/256); V=128+floor((112R-94G-18B+128)/256), clamp0..255. Shared chroma=(chroma_pixel0+chroma_pixel1+1)//2. DefaultYUYV; CTRL0[4] swaps U/V; IMAGE_MODE[0] swaps each adjacent byte pair.
source_scene.jpeg: Real independently implemented baseline8-bit JFIF YCbCr444 encoder in sensor, not CAM compression. Fullrange Y=(19595R+38470G+7471B+32768)//65536; U=128+(-11059R-21709G+32768B+32768)//65536; V=128+(32768R-27439G-5329B+32768)//65536, clamp0..255. Separable8x8 FDCT, uniform quant clamp(QS,1,63), DC prediction, zigzag/RLE, complete custom canonical Huffman DHT, stuffing and EOI. Image edge replication. No encoded fixtures, magic padding or libjpeg/VNC dependency.
source_scene.y8: IMAGE_MODE[6] selects one limited-range luminance byte per pixel for non-JPEG.

functional_timing_profile.name: ov2640-functional-dvp-v1
functional_timing_profile.line: line_bytes+16 PCLK cycles. Four VSYNC lines then four inactive lines then payload rows. COM10[4] chooses data-update edge, opposite edge latches stable bytes. Primary OmniVision v2.2 table13 page23 defines COM10[5]=0 always-output PCLK and COM10[5]=1 HREF-qualified PCLK (documented for DSP bypass); the processed-mode application is an explicit functional profile, not silicon qualification. The official component identifier COM10_PCLK_FREE is misleading relative to that explicit vendor table and is not used to invert the documented bit semantics. Bits3/1 invert HREF/VSYNC.
functional_timing_profile.jpeg_line: IMAGE_MODE[1] gives one contiguous HREF payload burst; otherwise line_bytes=2*width, ceil(encoded_length/line_bytes) rows. Final partial row has no emitted padding bytes. Exact proprietary compressed timing and AUTO divider behavior are not claimed.
functional_timing_profile.operations: Two bounded virtual timers per sensor. Atomic terminal-drive batches; changes-only finite-drive updates; no edge JSON/filesystem I/O.

request.frame: optional matching completed frame; nonzero leases snapshot until request frame0/omitted releases

capture_contract.response_payload: bytes integer array, timestamps_ns integer array, exactly requested count. Captured data is sampled from actually resolved D0..D7 at valid physical PCLK/HREF/VSYNC latch; unknown/contended sync/data is a precise dependency.
capture_contract.timestamps: frame_start_ns is virtual cycle0 latch slot at initial VSYNC; timestamp(k)=start+((8+k//line_bytes)*(line_bytes+16)+k%line_bytes)*2*half_period_ns. frame_end_ns=start+((line_count+8)*(line_bytes+16)-1)*2*half_period_ns. In gated blanking these prefix/blank slots are internal timer slots, not asserted physical PCLK edges; payload timestamps are actual asserted latch samples.
capture_contract.hash: FNV1a64 over actual completed emitted bytes, offset14695981039346656037 prime1099511628211, lowercase16hex. Host may independently SHA256 gathered immutable windows; no fabricated source/RX hash equivalence.
capture_contract.lifetime: Double-buffered completed-frame snapshot; matching frame lease freezes last buffer while streaming continues. Graph removal/replacement invalidates request. Larger runtime frame-buffer resize invalidates capture explicitly. Missing/stale/out-of-bounds window returns QOM error, not clipped or invented bytes.
capture_contract.bounds: 32 registered slots,2 timers each. Procedural source has no source-vector allocation. JPEG cap32MiB; actual allocation300bytes*3*ceil(width/8)*ceil(height/8)+512. Two capture buffers grow only on larger configured payload, each <=32MiB; no steady-state per-frame allocation. QOM serialization only on requested read.

unsupported_or_unqualified: Bare-die separate core/analog rails, optics, analog image processing/AE/AWB/gamma/lens/special effects are not modeled; component setting bytes remain readable/writable where written.
RAW10, reserved formats, DSP-bypass raw output, slave DVP, FREX/external shutter/snapshot mode, and programmable SS_ID SCCB address relocation are unsupported.
REGED programmed hold-last outputs on power-down is not implemented; declared/default profile tri-states outputs.

Proprietary compression microcode, exact sensor JPEG bitstream, compression latency/frame rate, AUTO PCLK divider rules, and factory-reserved reset defaults are not publicly qualified. Primary PDF explicitly says contact OmniVision for reference factory-reserved settings.
SCCB physical bit-edge qualification is not claimed for the existing owner transaction fast path.
